OpenLedger  ·  A reliable, deterministic ledger for your AI

About
  Place financial statements in a folder; your AI posts each row to a local ledger.

  Every entry is double-entry and data stays safely on your machine.

Usage
  oled               <command> [OPTIONS]

Commands
  status             Status: config, database, ledger counts, net worth (default)
  doctor             Diagnose the harness environment

  config             OpenLedger configuration
  ingest             Ingest pipeline: list / prepare / commit / done / fail

  transactions       Transactions: list / show / add / update / delete / recategorize / dedupe / merge
  accounts           Manage the chart of accounts
  merchants          Manage merchants and their default accounts
  questions          List, answer, and defer open questions
  report             Income, expenses, and net worth
  notes              Manage freeform notes
  datasets           Reference datasets
  open               Open the data folder in file explorer

Options
  --json             Emit NDJSON (machine-readable) instead of human output
  --no-color         Disable ANSI color output
  --config <path>    Config file to use (default ~/.oled/config.json)
  --version          Show the version and exit
  --help             Show this help screen

Contract
  Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 error · 2 usage · 3 not ready · 4 input required · 5 not found · 6 invalid · 7 partial.
  Under --json every stdout line is one JSON object, and list reads end with a {"type":"summary"} row.
  Errors are one stderr JSON object with a hint; read output masks PII as [USER]/[CARD], masks are not data.
